_source: Feat loop b3, lane b3-divine (2026-11-26): the channel, lay on hands, smite and performance feats a character USES. Each is had by a holder of the feat its `feat` names (rules/class_abilities.py `_docs_for`), run by the one executor. Benefit text from content/feats/feats.json (the OGL sheet), checked against aonprd.com FeatDisplay for each feat. A use 'of your channel energy' is `cost.uses_of`: one of a cleric's channel energy pool, two of a paladin's lay on hands (CRB p.62), read off whichever document answers to the name.
_grammar: rules/class_abilities.py, module docstring. The engine reads these fields and never these names.

abilities.name: Channel Smite
abilities.source: Channel Smite (CRB): 'Before you make a melee attack roll, you can choose to spend one use of your channel energy ability as a swift action. If you channel positive energy and you hit an undead creature, that creature takes an amount of additional damage equal to the damage dealt by your channel positive energy ability. If you channel negative energy and you hit a living creature ... Your target can make a Will save, as normal, to halve this additional damage. If your attack misses, the channel energy ability is still expended with no effect.'
abilities.text: Swift: your next melee blow carries your channel's dice into an undead (or, channelling negative energy, a living) foe; Will for half. A miss wastes it.
abilities._negative_note: The negative mode is open to a cleric (`class.channel-energy`); the owner's ruling 2026-10-05 lets any cleric channel either energy until alignment is tracked. A paladin channels positive energy only (CRB p.62).
abilities.tell: {name} gathers divine energy into the weapon.

abilities.name: Greater Channel Smite
abilities.source: Greater Channel Smite (UC): 'Before making any melee attacks on your turn, you can use a swift action to expend one daily use of your channel energy class feature. The dice from your channel energy feature form a pool of damage dice ... Prior to making each melee attack, allocate dice from the pool ... Your target can make a Will save, as normal, to halve this extra damage. This extra damage is not multiplied when you score a critical hit. If you miss, the extra damage dice remain in your pool, but any dice left unexpended at the end of your turn are wasted.'
abilities.text: Swift, before your blows: your channel's dice wait in the weapon until a melee blow lands on an undead (or living) foe this turn; Will for half. A miss keeps them.
abilities._allocation_note: The book lets the player split the pool across the turn's blows. The engine puts the whole pool on each blow until one lands — a miss keeps the dice, so that is the split a table makes when it wants the dice to land; owner call in the lane report.
abilities.tell: {name} gathers a pool of divine energy into the weapon.

abilities.name: Turn Undead
abilities.source: Turn Undead (CRB): 'You can, as a standard action, use one of your uses of channel positive energy to cause all undead within 30 feet of you to flee, as if panicked. Undead receive a Will save to negate the effect. The DC for this Will save is equal to 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Charisma modifier. Undead that fail their save flee for 1 minute. Intelligent undead receive a new saving throw each round to end the effect. If you use channel energy in this way, it has no other effect.'
abilities.text: Standard: every undead within 30 ft saves (Will) or flees, panicked, for a minute; the thinking dead may shake it off each round.
abilities.tell: {name} raises a holy symbol and turns the undead.

abilities.name: Life Lure
abilities.source: Life Lure (UM): 'As a standard action, you can channel positive energy to fascinate all undead within 30 feet for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1). Undead that succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Charisma modifier) are unaffected. Channeling energy for this purpose does not heal or harm creatures.'
abilities.text: Standard: every undead within 30 ft saves (Will) or stands fascinated for Cha rounds.
abilities.tell: {name} lets a warm glow of life spill out, and the dead turn towards it.

abilities.name: Command Undead
abilities.requires_said: with a cleric's channel energy (a paladin channels positive energy only)
abilities.source: Command Undead (CRB): 'As a standard action, you can use one of your uses of channel negative energy to enslave undead within 30 feet. Undead receive a Will save to negate the effect. The DC for this Will save is equal to 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Charisma modifier. Undead that fail their saves fall under your control ... Intelligent undead receive a new saving throw each day to resist your command. You can control any number of undead, so long as their total Hit Dice do not exceed your cleric level.'
abilities.text: Standard: undead within 30 ft save (Will) or fall under your command, up to your level in Hit Dice all told.
abilities.tell: {name} channels negative energy and calls the dead to heel.
not_yet: An intelligent undead's new saving throw each day: the command holds until it is ended.
Commands out of a fight: a commanded undead fights on its master's side in an encounter; it does not follow or take orders between fights.
The opposed Charisma check when another creature's orders conflict.

abilities.name: Elemental Channel
abilities.source: Elemental Channel (CRB): 'Instead of its normal effect, you can choose to have your ability to channel energy heal or harm outsiders of your chosen elemental subtype. You must make this choice each time you channel energy. If you choose to heal or harm creatures of your elemental subtype, your channel energy has no affect on other creatures. The amount of damage healed or dealt and the DC to halve the damage is otherwise unchanged.' Each taking names a new subtype: Elemental Channel (fire) holds `channel.elemental.fire`, which opens that subtype's two modes.
abilities.text: Standard: channel to heal or harm only the outsiders of your elemental subtype, in a 30-ft burst.
abilities.tell: {name} channels energy shaped to the elements.

abilities.name: Quick Channel
abilities.source: Quick Channel (UM): 'You may channel energy as a move action by spending 2 daily uses of that ability.'
abilities.text: Channel energy as a move action, for two of its uses (name the mode in brackets as for Channel Energy).
abilities.tell: {name} channels energy in a quick burst.

abilities.name: Crusader's Fist
abilities.source: Crusader's Fist (UC): 'When you attack with an unarmed strike and hit a creature that you can harm with your lay on hands or touch of corruption feature, you can use a swift action to expend a daily use of that feature to deal its normal damage as if you had hit with the feature's normal touch attack. This extra damage is not multiplied if you scored a critical hit.' The use is spent when the fist lands on such a creature, not before.
abilities.text: Your unarmed blows this round carry lay on hands into the undead: its dice on the first that lands on one, for a use.
abilities.tell: {name} closes a fist around holy power.
not_yet: Touch of corruption (the antipaladin's): no antipaladin is playable.

abilities.name: Radiant Charge
abilities.source: Radiant Charge (UM): 'When you hit with a charge attack, you can expend all of your remaining uses of lay on hands to deal extra damage equal to 1d6 per use of lay on hands expended + your Charisma bonus. This damage comes from holy power and is not subject to damage reduction, energy immunities, or energy resistances.' Declared before the charge; spent when its blow lands.
abilities.text: Your next charge, if it hits: every remaining use of lay on hands as 1d6 each + Cha of holy damage past all reduction.
abilities.tell: {name} lowers into a charge, holy light gathering.

abilities.name: Adept Champion
abilities.source: Adept Champion (UC): 'While using your smite evil class feature, as a swift action at the start of your turn, you can forgo the bonus on damage rolls and instead gain half that bonus as a bonus on combat maneuver checks against the target of your smite. The effects of your smite evil feature return to normal at the start of your next turn.'
abilities.text: Swift, while smiting: trade the smite's damage bonus against its target for half of it on combat manoeuvres, until your next turn.
abilities.tell: {name} turns the smite from wounding {target} to overpowering them.

abilities.name: Word of Healing
abilities.source: Word of Healing (UM): 'You may use your lay on hands to heal another creature at a range of 30 feet as a standard action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity. You must be able to speak and have a free hand to use this ability. The target heals half the amount they would have healed if you had touched them, but gains the benefits of your mercies as normal.' A use of lay on hands, so its mercies and the feats that ride it come along.
abilities.text: Standard: lay on hands on another creature up to 30 ft away, for half the healing, mercies as normal.

abilities.name: Bewildering Koan
abilities.source: Bewildering Koan (Gnomes of Golarion): 'As a swift action, spend 1 point from your ki pool and make a Bluff check by asking a creature one of the impossible questions you ponder when meditating. If the creature fails its check, you choose whether it loses its next action or you gain a +2 bonus on all damage rolls you make against that creature for 1 round.' The creature's check is its Sense Motive against the Bluff; 'loses its next action' is dazed for a round (owner call).
abilities.text: Swift, 1 ki: Bluff against a foe's Sense Motive; beaten, it loses its next action, or you gain +2 damage against it for a round.
abilities.tell: {name} asks {target} a question with no answer.
